# The staged-debt refusal roster.
#
# Every structural refusal kind the runtime can mint that the kernel model
# corpus does not yet carry a refusal row for, with the ticket that owns
# closing the gap. DEV-804 replaces each row here with its corpus declaration.
#
# This file is a reviewed control, never a source. Nothing generates it and no
# generator reads it. `check:refusal-vocabulary` reads the shipped runtime
# union out of the truth-plane module's source bytes and the refusal reasons
# out of the interchange fixture's bytes, then requires every kind the corpus
# does not carry to be pinned here. Adding a spelling to the generator manifest
# and regenerating is therefore not enough to keep the wall green: the debt has
# to be written down here as well, by hand, in a diff a reviewer reads.
#
# Format: one `<kind> <ticket>` line per waived kind, in the union's order.
